influences.name: Prince
influences.context: Prince was one of my favorites growing up. It was always public knowledge that he was the writer, the composer, produced everything, and played all the instruments. I loved that.

influences.name: Todd Rundgren
influences.context: Todd Rundgren was another one of my favorites who did that. I wanted to learn it all and know how to do it all.

influences.name: Thin Lizzy
influences.context: I listened to it and I felt like, 'Oh, there's a Thin Lizzy moment'... That's exactly a lot of the references that are there. Obviously, a lot of my influences as well.

influences.name: Billy Joel
influences.context: I listened to it and I felt like... 'a Billy Joel Glass Houses bit'... That's exactly a lot of the references that are there. Obviously, a lot of my influences as well.

influences.name: Mike Campbell
influences.context: I listened to it and I felt like... 'That reminds me of Mike Campbell with Don Henley.'... That's exactly a lot of the references that are there. Obviously, a lot of my influences as well.
